name: c0de Statements
landing_text: This book lists the keyword blocks of c0de. A keyword block starts a line and decides what the line does. Some of them, like PARAMETER or ELSE, only work together with others. Each page shows what a block does, how to craft it and a short example. The examples use the text notation of the guide: one text line is one line on the sheet, and four spaces mean one block further east.
